title: Medicare Anti-Aβ mAb Coverage With Evidence Development (CED) Study
official: Prospective Study on Anti-Amyloid-β Monoclonal Antibodies Directed Against Amyloid for the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease Coverage of Evidence Development (The Anti-Aβ mAb CED Study)
summary: The Anti-Aβ mAb CED Study is a prospective, longitudinal coverage with evidence development (CED) study using clinical data, patient assessments, and administrative claims data of the Medicare population, conducted in accordance to the National Coverage Determination (NCD) on Monoclonal Antibodies Directed Against Amyloid for the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease (AD).
conditions: Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) Due to Alzheimer's Disease

interventions.name: Monoclonal Antibodies Directed Against Amyloid for the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Medicare patients with a clinical diagnosis of mild cognitive impairment due to Alzheimer's disease (AD) or mild AD dementia, both with confirmed presence of amyloid beta pathology consistent with AD.

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
sponsor: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services/ Coverage and Analysis Group

sites.f: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services
